name: Gale Frenzy

items.name: Distracting Whispers
items.text:
A gale frenzy can focus all of their whispered words in a cacophony of unsettling and distracting threats, lies, and taunts, assaulting the minds of those they target with the plethora of distinct sounds. The gale frenzy selects one creature within 90 feet and fills its mind with these wind-borne distractions. The targeted creature must attempt a DC 28 Will save save with the following results. The gale frenzy can't use Distracting Whispers again for 1d4 rounds.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes 10d6 mental damage and is Stupefied 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is Stupefied 2 for 1 minute.

items.name: Putrid Plague
items.text:
The Sickened and Unconscious conditions from putrid plague can't end or be reduced until the disease is cured.

Saving Throw DC 25 Fortitude save

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1d4 hours)

Stage 2 sickened (1 day)

Stage 3 Sickened 1 and Slowed 1 (1 day)

Stage 4 unconscious (1 day)

Stage 5 dead

items.name: Ravenous Winds
items.text: The gale frenzy combines its powers over the wind to draw prey closer. Each segment of the troop selects a different target within 20 feet; a targeted creature must succeed at a DC 28 Fortitude save save or be pulled adjacent to that segment of the troop. If a target was pulled off the ground and cannot fly, it then falls as normal.

items.name: Talonstorm
items.text:
1 to 3

Frequency once per round

---
Effect The gale frenzy swoops through an area with their talons arrayed in a harrowing wall of slashing peril as they rip at each enemy in a 5-foot emanation. Targets must attempt a DC 25 basic Reflex save save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 1d8+2 slashing damage (plus putrid plague on a failure)

2 3d8+4 slashing damage (plus putrid plague on a failure)

3 5d8+6 slashing damage (plus putrid plague on a failure)

text:
A flock of harpies sometimes forms a tight-knit bond that transcends family ties, personal goals, and individual morals. Like a murmuration of starlings, these so-called gale frenzies begin operating like a superorganism whose movements and thoughts align with uncanny coordination.
Harpies at War
On the battlefield, harpies traditionally prefer roles more akin to skirmishers or assassins, deadly killers who take advantage of trickery and stealth to accomplish goals of weakening an enemy force. Gale frenzies are a notable exception to this, and a harpy community that includes a gale frenzy is never hesitant to send such a troop into battle instead.
